# InklingMD

[![CI](https://github.com/zhkp/InklingMD/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhkp/InklingMD/actions) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](/zhkp/InklingMD/blob/main/LICENSE)

A **WYSIWYG** Markdown editor built with [Tauri](https://tauri.app) and *Milkdown*. ✨

## Features

- Live preview with `GFM` tables
- Math via [KaTeX](docs/math.md)
  - inline and block formulas

- [x] Smart Paste
- [ ] Plugin system

## Install

```shell
pnpm install
pnpm tauri dev
```

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl`+`P` | Quick open |
